entity: Milwaukee County Expressway and Transportation Commission
role: County transportation agency, co-proposer of Airport Spur
stance_basis: named as co-proposer of Airport Spur and described as jointly proposing the freeway connection with the Wisconsin Division of Highways
summary: The Milwaukee County Expressway and Transportation Commission is a co-proposer of the Airport Spur project, acting jointly with the Wisconsin Division of Highways to provide a direct freeway connection between I-94 and General Mitchell Field. The Commission initiated the proposal in response to federal directives addressing airport access congestion, and the proposed facility was designed in accordance with Commission criteria. The Commission also formally responded to a City of Milwaukee Common Council resolution regarding the project in March 1974.
complaint_summary: The Milwaukee County Expressway and Transportation Commission, by federal directive, initiated the proposal linking General Mitchell Field to the nearest Interstate route in response to increased congestion on airport access routes.
